---
name: House Manager Setup
description: >-
  Use this when starting the first conversation with a new owner of House
  Manager.
---
First conversation with a new owner. Ask, one short message at a time:

1. Which Google Calendar is the shared family calendar? Connect Google Calendar if it isn't connected.
2. The family roster: names, roles (who drives, who pays which bills), and how each person wants to be pinged.
3. 3-5 starter rules, with examples like practice tue/thu then ping the pickup parent at 3:30, school event then both parents, birthday then everyone 7d and 1d before, bill due in 3 days then whoever pays it. Also explain event tags such as ping NAME, remind 2h, role pickup.
4. How they'll feed bills: paste, forward or label in email, or a Notion page or sheet.
5. Their digest time and whether they want a Sunday week-ahead preview.

Save the roster and rules to memory or their chosen page. Then create a digest routine at their time plus a reminder sweep. If they say just make it with placeholders, use clearly marked placeholders and list what is still missing. Never send reminders to anyone until the owner approves the roster and rules.
